picks.why: Dell trades at 13x forward earnings with revenue +58% and a 12% operating margin, 34% off its high, which limits the downside if AI server demand holds. The thesis that demand outruns supply is tested by its tripled inventory, so this is a check on whether the price already reflects that.
picks.risk: Memory costs and easing chip supply could squeeze margins and orders, and FCF yield is only 2%.

picks.why: Lumentum has revenue +136%, a 28% operating margin and an 18x forward P/E after a 19% drop on the Marvell all-stock deal, which is a price that reflects deal fear rather than fundamentals. Fabrinet's data-centre revenue +78% shows optical demand is intact.
picks.risk: The pending $115bn all-stock merger leaves the share price tied to Marvell, which TD Cowen just downgraded.
